services.desc: If you're a girl looking to learn jiu jitsu, here's a quick list to help you decide if it's right for you. The Brazilian art of Jiu Jitsu cleanses you of your old tired notions of what you think physical self defense looks like and replaces them with practical and applicable skills (that can also double as recreational activity). Here are some reasons why every girl should start training jiu jitsu: Jiu jitsu teaches girls that they can be powerful despite their size and give them confidence in living their day to day lives, to be less afraid of dark shadows. blurb: The Foundations program focuses on teaching the essential skills of grappling that work seamlessly in both gi and no-gi training. Students will learn how to safely and effectively take their opponent to the ground with takedowns, establish and maintain control through strong pinning techniques, and escape from bad positions such as mount, side control, or back control.
